Home.intro: Personal colors, Hanbok styling, palace routes, local food and Korean culture — connected into one trip instead of six separate searches.
Home.context: Launching around Gyeongbokgung first. Free local discovery stays useful; credits unlock computation-heavy personalized features.
Home.modulesIntro: Each module can feed the next: color guidance can shape Hanbok choices, Hanbok can shape a photo route, and available time can shape food and nearby stops.
Home.travelerIntro: Your explicit choices always outrank market defaults. We do not infer nationality, ethnicity, religion or other sensitive identity traits from names, faces or language.
Home.freeText: Destinations, basic place browsing, cultural explainers and Quick Help stay accessible without buying credits.
Home.paidText: AI-heavy reports, visual generation and premium planning show a fixed credit cost before you confirm.
Home.internationalText: Language, route friction, food filters and practical travel information are localized without stereotyping individual travelers.

Color.title: Find colors worth trying in Korea.
Color.intro: Start with a private browser-side selfie scan, review the estimate, then carry the palette into your Hanbok recommendation. The preview is styling guidance, not a professional diagnosis.

ColorScanner.emptyText: Face forward in natural light. Avoid strong filters, colored lighting and deep shadows.
ColorScanner.resultDisclaimer: This is a photo-based estimate under the current lighting, not a professional personal-color diagnosis. You can correct the result before using it for Hanbok matching.
ColorScanner.browserPrivacy: Your selfie stays in this browser for this free preview.
ColorScanner.sensitiveTraitNote: The scan uses visible color pixels only for styling guidance. It does not identify you or infer race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, health or attractiveness.

warnings.darkPhoto: The photo looks dark. Daylight may give a more reliable result.
warnings.overexposedPhoto: The face area looks overexposed. Try softer natural light.
warnings.limitedPixels: We found limited face-like color pixels, so please review the estimate manually.

errors.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot run the local photo scan.
errors.insufficientPixels: We could not read enough usable pixels. Try a brighter, front-facing photo.
errors.unknown: We could not analyze this photo. Try another clear selfie.

ColorScanner.shootingGuide1: Face natural, indirect daylight (avoid direct sunlight glare)
ColorScanner.shootingGuide2: Remove sunglasses and hats; look directly forward
ColorScanner.shootingGuide3: Avoid heavy beauty filters or colored indoor lighting
ColorScanner.evidence1Body: Visible overtone tendency under current lighting.
ColorScanner.evidence2Body: Tonal separation between skin, eyes, and hair.
ColorScanner.evidence3Body: Reflectance range that keeps your features clear.
ColorScanner.evidence4Body: Prefers gentle harmonious tones over harsh neon chroma.
ColorScanner.whyColorsTitle: Why some colors flatter while others feel heavy
ColorScanner.whyNavyWorks: Harmonious Tone: Creates clear facial definition without casting muddy shadows.
ColorScanner.whyMustardFails: Challenging Tone: May cast yellowish shadows or compete with natural facial contrast.
ColorScanner.variationText: Seasonal sun exposure, indoor fluorescent lamps, makeup, or dyed hair can shift visible tones. Retest under clean morning daylight for highest consistency.
